import numpy as np, json

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

def f(inp):

    for r in range(H):

    bgc=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    items=[(k,v) for k,v in cnt.items() if k!=bgc]

# Verify corner rule reproduction once more and prepare candidates
import os,re,numpy as np,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(inp):
    i=np.array(inp); H,W=i.shape
    cnt=Counter(i.ravel())
    X=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]          # block fill color
    seprows=[r for r in range(H) if not (i[r]==X).any()]
    sepcols=[c for c in range(W) if not (i[:,c]==X).any()]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(seprows,seprows[1:]):
        row=[]
        for x,y in zip(sepcols,sepcols[1:]):
            cs=(int(i[a,x]),int(i[a,y]),int(i[b,x]),int(i[b,y]))
            row.append(int(cs[0]) if len(set(cs))==1 and cs[0]!=X else int(X))
        out.append(row)
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print('test (uniform->fill):', json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
print('test (uniform-bg->bg?): need bg color')

import os,re,json,numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def analyze(i):
    i=np.array(i); H,W=i.shape
    cnt=Counter(i.ravel().tolist()); X=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if not (i[r]!=X).any()]
    sc=[c for c in range(W) if not (i[:,c]!=X).any()]
    return i,X,sr,sc

for k in ['Demo pair %d'%i for i in range(1,4)]:
    i=Xs,sr,sc=analyze(G[k+' input']); o=G[k+' output']
    print(k, 'in shape',i.shape, 'out shape',np.array(o).shape, 'fill',X,'seprows',sr,'sepcols',sc)
    if hasattr(Xs,'__getitem__'): break

import numpy as np, json, os, re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[]
        for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]:
            parts=[p.strip() for p in r.split()]
            if len(parts)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in parts):
                rows.append([int(p) for p in parts])
        if k not in G and rows: G[k]=rows
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(inp):
    i=np.array(inp); H,W=i.shape
    cnt=Counter(i.ravel().tolist())
    rank=cnt.most_common()
    X=rank[0][0]                         # fill
    S=rank[1][0] if len(rank)>1 else None # separator line color
    marks=[v for v,n in cnt.items() if v not in (X,S)]   # marker colors
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if not (i[r]==X).any()]
    sc=[c for c in range(W) if not (i[:,c]==X).any()]
    kr=[r for r in sr if any(i[r,c] in marks for c in range(W))]
    kc=[c for c in sc if any(i[r,c] in marks for r in range(H))]
    rows_gaps=list(zip(kr,kr[1:])) if len(kr)>1 else [(None,None)]
    cols_gaps=list(zip(kc,kc[1:])) if len(kc)>1 else [(None,None)]
    out=[]
    for ra,rb in rows_gaps:
        if ra is None: continue
        r=[]
        for ca,cb in cols_gaps:
            cs=set(int(i[ra,ca]),int(i[ra,cb]),int(i[rb,ca]),int(i[rb,cb]))
            r.append(cs.pop() if len(cs)==1 else X)
        out.append(r)
    return out

    got=f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); exp=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    m=got==exp
    ok&=m
    print(i, m, got, exp)
print('ALL:', ok)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

from collections import Counter
def load():

    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(inp):

import numpy as np, os, re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[]
        for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]:
            parts=[p.strip() for p in r.split()]
            if len(parts)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in parts):
                rows.append([int(p) for p in parts])
        if k not in G and rows: G[k]=rows
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
